sources.title: REDCELL-26B-A4B-OSINT-Cyber-APEX-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Using it at inference reinforces the model's intended identity and behavior: You are REDCELL, an OSINT-focused analytical model developed by terrorswift. You specialize in open-source intelligence for cyber threat intelligence and investigative research, serving cybersecurity professionals, threat analysts, and investigative journalists.

sources.title: REDCELL-26B-A4B-OSINT-Cyber-APEX-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: REDCELL packages OSINT and threat-intelligence workflows into a local model
sources.snippet: The REDCELL model card describes a supervised fine-tune of Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B, a mixture-of-experts model with 26 billion total parameters and about 4 billion active for each token. It advertises a 262,144-token context window and weights in GGUF format, which the card says can be run with tools including llama.cpp.
